correctness.rationale: The local 3-column predicate is logically equivalent to one-limited domination on every vertex. Closed 16-state walks give exactly one weight per labelled vertex subset. The finite symbolic matrix characteristic factorization is reproducible and yields the rational identity. Edge counting gives the half-order minimum and exact equality as a perfect matching cut; mixed/homogeneous column cases exhaust all minima. Complex-root comparison gives the count asymptotic. Every coefficient was independently checked by direct graph enumeration for n=3..8, and minimum multiplicity for n=9..20.

value.rationale: The full cardinality profile solves a natural and motivated enumeration problem for a canonical infinite family of cubic Cartesian products in a newly studied domination model. A reduced degree-eight denominator makes arbitrarily large profiles exactly computable; the period-four jump from two to six minima and the total-count exponential growth rate identify nontrivial structure. These are not the known scalar lower bound or a mere substitution into a generic formula.
